_meta.source: The 4 test personas from docs/QUESTIONNAIRE_DISCOVERY.md (Sandbox success criteria). Names, emails, phones and addresses are made up; never put real client details here.
_meta.expectedSteps: The step ids each household should see, given its answers. The persona tests compare this list with the steps the rules actually show.
_meta.answers: Keyed by question id from questionnaire.json. Skipped questions are simply left out. Hidden questions are never answered here.
_meta.soloNewBuild: The persona note says 'rarely hosts'. Only 'Never' skips Entertaining (team decision 2026-11-06), so this household answers Never to test the skip.

samples.label: Growing family renovation
samples.note: Two parents, kids aged 7 and 10, a dog. Entertains often. Should see every step.

answers.name: Maya and Sam Example
answers.timeline: Before next summer. Grandparents are visiting for a month in July.
answers.years_here: Four years so far, and we plan to stay until the kids finish school.
answers.excited: A kitchen where everyone can be in the same room.
answers.nervous: Living through it with two kids and a dog.
answers.toys: Everywhere, mostly the living room floor.
answers.pet_durability: Sheds a lot and comes in muddy.
answers.morning: Sam is up first and makes lunches. Everyone eats at the island and leaves by 8.
answers.storage_focus: Shoes and sports gear at the back door.
answers.hosting_wishes: Room for everyone to sit at one table.
answers.home_meaning: Where everyone comes back to at the end of the day.
answers.taste_differences: Sam likes darker colours than I do.
answers.design_elements: Lots of light and warm wood.
answers.features: A big island and a mudroom bench.
answers.green_details: Better windows, if the cost makes sense.
answers.anything_else: Biscuit needs a spot by the door to dry off.

samples.label: Furniture and styling couple
samples.note: Couple in their 60s, no kids or pets. Should skip Kids and Pets, and never see square feet, contractor or Green/LEED.

answers.name: Ruth and Alan Example
answers.years_here: Twenty years, and we're not going anywhere.
answers.past_experience: Good, but it was a long time ago.
answers.morning: Coffee and the paper in the sunroom.
answers.hosting_wishes: Chairs that are comfortable for a long dinner.
answers.travel_details: Europe once a year, for pleasure.
answers.anything_else: We'd like to keep the piano.

samples.label: Solo professional, new build
samples.note: Lives alone, works from home full time, travels for business, never hosts. Should skip Kids, Pets and Entertaining, and never see the shared taste questions.

answers.name: Jordan Example
answers.timeline: Move in by fall next year.
answers.years_here: New build, so we'll see. At least ten years.
answers.excited: Designing an office I actually want to work in.
answers.past_experience: Great. The architect is designing this house.
answers.morning: Gym, then straight to the desk by 7:30.
answers.work_needs: Video calls all day, two monitors, a door that closes.
answers.home_meaning: A place to recharge between trips.
answers.green_details: Solar panels and a heat pump.

samples.label: Multi-generational addition
samples.note: Two parents, a teenager and a grandparent with mobility needs. Should see Kids (the teen is under 18) but skip Pets, and see the shared taste questions (3 adults).

answers.name: Priya Example
answers.timeline: Within a year. Nani is moving in full time.
answers.years_here: Ten years, and this is our forever home.
answers.excited: Nani having her own space close to us.
answers.considerations_notes: Nani uses a walker. No steps into her suite, and a walk-in shower.
answers.morning: Nani is up first and makes chai for everyone.
answers.storage_focus: Nani's medical supplies, and the garage.
answers.work_needs: A quiet spot for calls two days a week.
answers.hosting_wishes: A bigger dining area and a second oven.
answers.travel_details: India every two years to see family.
answers.taste_differences: Arjun wants modern, Nani wants traditional.
answers.features: Walk-in shower, grab bars that don't look clinical.
answers.anything_else: Nani should be able to reach the kitchen without stairs.
